pages.text: White fog covered the morning. Only the stone wall stretched from the hill to their yard.
The sheep huddled on the hill. "I will bring them home before the fog thickens." Pipo climbed up.
Grandpa Sheep appeared in the fog. "The old path is best on a day like this. Follow me."
Grandpa led the way down. The sound of water underfoot grew closer.
Splash! Grandpa's foot went into the stream. "Oh dear, was the stream here?"
White fog filled both sides. Grandpa turned around and around on the spot.
"I used to walk here with my eyes closed." Fog beaded on his beard.
Pipo put a hand on the stone wall. "This wall goes all the way to our yard!"
Touching the wall, he walked one step at a time. The sheep followed it in a line.
Their yard emerged from the fog. Mom waved at the door. Grandpa followed, tapping the wall. Drops fell from the end of his beard.
